verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own marketing says admins can create custom vesting schedules and vary them by group, so the core capability exists. Nothing in the evidence describes cliffs, milestone-based vesting, exit acceleration or automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking. Tranche-level detail in financial reports only hints at tracking. Missing for 10: documented cliff configuration, milestone/performance vesting, acceleration on exit (single/double trigger), explicit automatic vested vs unvested tracking, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: Switch up vesting schedules for different groups, or create custom vesting to reflect your needs.
with tranche-level details in one click
